name: VibePrompt
summary: Library of 286 UI section prompts with Tailwind CSS code, grouped into 15 section categories.
description: A prompt library for building page sections with AI tools: 286 prompts in 15 categories, from auth forms, pricing tables and hero sections to FAQ, testimonials, dashboards, onboarding and blog layouts. Each entry pairs a detailed layout prompt — fixing type scale, CTA hierarchy, states and responsive behaviour — with ready-to-paste Tailwind CSS code, and item pages show the full prompt with a live preview. Prompts get pasted into Claude, Cursor, v0 or any AI coding tool.
contains: categories: auth forms, pricing, features/bento, hero, CTA, stats, navbar, testimonials, footer, FAQ
also: dashboards, onboarding, blog/content, contact and 29 bonus prompts
each entry gives a layout prompt plus ready-to-paste Tailwind CSS code
prompt pages show the full prompt text, design credit and a live preview
